prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1224; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state whether you understand that this call is being recorded.

A: Yes, I understand it's being recorded.

Q: Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving on the main road in Katy, Texas, heading toward the shopping center. Traffic had slowed down ahead of me.

Q: What happened next?

A: I stopped behind a car at the light. The next thing I knew, I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back, and my knee hit the dashboard.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No, I didn't. I was looking at the car in front of me. I never saw it coming.

Q: Did you call for medical help or go to a hospital?

A: The paramedics came out, and they checked me over. I refused the ambulance at first, but my knee got worse, so I went to the emergency room later that afternoon.

Q: Can you describe your knee injury?

A: It's swollen and painful. I have trouble bending it and sometimes it gives out when I stand up. The doctor said I might need an MRI and physical therapy.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?

A: Yes, I've been out for about a week. I work on my feet, so I can't do my job right now.

Q: Did you have any prior injuries to that knee?

A: I had a minor sprain years ago, but it healed completely. I hadn't had any problems with it recently.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car fixed and get my knee back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
